summary: Map versioned SOC 2, CIS and NIST controls to dated evidence; identify unsupported and unknown control claims.
limitations: The built-in rules inspect bounded supplied artifacts; absence of findings does not establish safety.
Isolated laboratory acceptance and production integrations require separate execution evidence.
Unsupported formats require a registered acquisition or parsing adapter with pinned prerequisites.

demo.description: Compare vulnerable, corrected, insufficient and benign synthetic evidence.
